title: SQL injection in /user
description:
The `name` parameter is concatenated into a SQL query:

```python
db.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'")
```

Joern traces `request.args` to `db.execute` with no sanitiser.
impact: An unauthenticated user can read or change any data in the database.
reproduction:
- Code review: app.py lines 11-14
- Joern flow in joern-flows.json
remediation:
Use a parameterised query:

```python
db.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?", (name,))
```

title: OS command injection in /ping
remediation: Pass an argument list without a shell and validate `host` as an IP address or hostname.
impact: An attacker who reaches /src/rv-demo-app/app.py:17-20 can exploit this without credentials.
reproduction: Send a crafted request to /src/rv-demo-app/app.py:17-20 (see the evidence).

title: Vulnerable PyYAML 5.3
description: PyYAML 5.3 has known arbitrary code execution vulnerabilities.
impact: An attacker who reaches /src/rv-demo-app/requirements.txt can exploit this without credentials.
reproduction: Send a crafted request to /src/rv-demo-app/requirements.txt (see the evidence).
